blocks.md: For most commuters the **gravel bike** is the sweet spot: nearly road-bike speed, but it shrugs off potholes, takes full fenders and racks, and doubles as a weekend bike. A **road bike** only wins if your route is long, smooth and you value speed above all. A **hybrid** wins on budget, comfort and zero-fuss practicality for shorter city rides.
blocks.title: Quick verdict

options: Long and fast on smooth pavement
